title: Thai-Style Grilled Pork
description: A quick and flavorful grilled pork dish inspired by Thai cuisine, perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together fish sauce, palm sugar, and grated ginger.
3. Rub the mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
4. Place the pork on the grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
5. While the pork is cooking, combine coconut milk, lime juice, and toasted peanuts in a small bowl.
6. Once the pork is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
7. Serve the pork with the coconut milk sauce spooned over the top and garnished with cilantro.
